apps.name: Agent Project Bootstrap
apps.tagline: Cursor agent bootstrap for FOSS projects.
apps.description: GitHub template for bootstrapping FOSS projects with Cursor agents: labeled BUILD_PLAN sprints, CI guardrails, Dependabot triage, and Golden Path stubs for Web, Python, and Android.

apps.name: Hermes Launcher
apps.tagline: Home-screen inbox for notifications, news, and podcasts.
apps.description: FOSS Android home-screen inbox. Cards for notifications, news, and podcasts dismiss only via X. Local vault, MIT licensed.

apps.name: Continuum Calendar
apps.tagline: Rolling-week calendar with Google sync.
apps.description: FOSS cross-platform calendar: Tauri desktop plus Android, rolling week view, Continuum brand, optional Google sync.

apps.name: AstroAlarm
apps.tagline: Alarm clock driven by solar and lunar events.
apps.description: FOSS Android astronomical alarm clock with on-device NOAA/Meeus ephemeris, custom clock wheels, lockscreen math unlock, and a day/night widget.

apps.name: OpenShouter
apps.tagline: Speaks the alerts you choose so you can look away.
apps.description: FOSS Android TTS that speaks chosen alerts. Built for people who cannot see or read a screen, and for anyone silencing the phone to check it less. No Play Services.

apps.name: Multi App Share
apps.tagline: Share one item to many apps in sequence.
apps.description: Android utility that shares photos, videos, or text across custom app groups in a guided sequential workflow instead of repeating the share sheet.

apps.name: SyncMark
apps.tagline: Unify bookmarks across browsers; find dead links.
apps.description: Local-first cross-browser bookmark unifier with dead-link checking and category suggestions.

apps.name: SelfChronicle
apps.tagline: Local-first personal memory and living biography.
apps.description: Privacy-first personal memory vault that turns exports and notes into a living biography, key facts, and an auditable timeline you own. PWA plus optional Android wrapper.

apps.name: Vault Organizer
apps.tagline: Offline Obsidian plugin that auto-tags and files notes.
apps.description: Offline Obsidian plugin using local FOSS embeddings to auto-tag, categorize, and folder notes without cloud AI.

apps.name: AetherFeed
apps.tagline: Encrypted local-first news, podcasts, and booru.
apps.description: Local-first encrypted news, podcast, and booru client. Read offline, keep stars and playback private, optionally sync opaque backups. No account, no telemetry.

apps.name: Point and Shoot
apps.tagline: FOSS pro camera for Camera2 devices.
apps.description: FOSS professional camera app with HUD controls, LUT workflows, bracketing, and advanced capture pipelines for capable Android Camera2 devices.

apps.name: Quick Media Ingest
apps.tagline: Fast media import into dated shoot folders.
apps.description: FOSS .NET 8 WPF media importer for photographers. Ingest from SD cards, local drives, and FTP into dated shoot folders.

apps.name: NoClip Auto
apps.tagline: Auto-fix highlight and shadow clipping in Lightroom.
apps.description: Lightroom Classic plugin that auto-fixes highlight and shadow clipping. FOSS, local-only, Windows and macOS.

apps.name: Hover Icons
apps.tagline: Photorealistic 3D icon pack from a YAML catalog.
apps.description: FOSS photorealistic 3D icon pack generated from a locked YAML catalog. Same outline in 2D and 3D; tame or neon from one source. MIT code, CC0 assets.

apps.name: QRaft
apps.tagline: Custom QR codes for widgets and wallpapers.
apps.description: Craft custom QR codes for widgets, lock-screen glance panels, and full-screen wallpapers. Offline F-Droid-friendly Android app.

apps.name: DevPulse
apps.tagline: See which installed apps still have a heartbeat.
apps.description: Local-only Android scanner that checks Play, F-Droid repos, and public forges so you can find stale software, replacements, or repos worth forking.

apps.name: Screen Wakelock Detector
apps.tagline: Find what wakes your screen; mute it locally.
apps.description: See the app and channel that wakes your screen, then mute it in one tap. All local, no cloud.

apps.name: OBDForge
apps.tagline: Multi-transport OBD-II live data and diagnostics.
apps.description: FOSS Android OBD-II diagnostics with BT/USB/WiFi/Ethernet, OBDLink STN support, live data, and local AI assists. F-Droid friendly.

apps.name: Expedition Gauge
apps.tagline: Offline-first automotive HUD with record and playback.
apps.description: Offline-first automotive HUD with recording, playback, and optional live telemetry. FOSS MIT.

apps.name: ChromaFlow
apps.tagline: Fans, pumps, and lighting in one Linux Mint app.
apps.description: Control PC fans, pumps, and lighting from a single Linux Mint desktop app.

apps.name: JanusBoot
apps.tagline: UEFI-first graphical boot manager.
apps.description: UEFI-first graphical boot manager built around Limine, ESP settings, and janusbootctl.

apps.name: 3D Game Optimizer
apps.tagline: One-click glasses-free 3D PC gaming hub.
apps.description: Hub that streamlines glasses-free 3D PC gaming setup and optimization in one click.

apps.name: StarRupture City Planner
apps.tagline: Offline PWA to plan StarRupture city layouts.
apps.description: Offline PWA to plan West-to-East StarRupture city layouts from an unlock checklist. FOSS MIT.

apps.name: Google Messages for Desktop
apps.tagline: Native desktop window for Google Messages.
apps.description: FOSS Electron app for Google Messages for web on Windows, macOS, and Linux. Native window, tray unread badge, OS toasts, and sms/tel/im compose.

apps.name: TakeIn SMS
apps.tagline: Google Voice Takeout to Android SMS.
apps.description: Windows GUI plus ADB tool that imports Google Voice Takeout archives onto Android as SMS messages.

apps.name: Linear Trend Spotter
apps.tagline: Crypto scanner with momentum gates and dashboard.
apps.description: Python scanner for liquid exchange-listed coins: volume and momentum gates, uniformity scoring, strategy backtests, and a public JSON dashboard.

apps.name: TrendAlgo Bot
apps.tagline: Self-hosted crypto algo bot stack.
apps.description: Self-hosted crypto algo stack with Freqtrade, LTS Scanner, portfolio tracker, and AI-recommended strategies.
